mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tight labor market that accelerates corporate hiring and profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE decline and PAYEMS growth fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime characterized by rising housing starts and strong retail sales, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns as consumer spending and construction activity boost corporate revenues and earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 650000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO YoY change > 0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.5%), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.5% and FEDFUNDS YoY change > 0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction between RSAFS growth and HOUST growth fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3 years.
